summary: Maris-Tech Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer listed on Nasdaq, filed a Form 6-K furnishing notice of a Special General Meeting of Shareholders set for November 10, 2026, at its Rehovot offices, with a record date of October 23, 2026. The sole agenda item seeks approval for one or more reverse share splits at ratios of no less than 1-for-2 and cumulative no more than 1-for-250, exercisable at board discretion within 18 months of the meeting. The Board unanimously recommends a vote in favor; no advisor is named. This is a routine meeting notice, not a special situation; watch for split timing and Nasdaq minimum-bid compliance.
